profiles.Inventory: Collects configuration inventory without issuing most security conclusions.
profiles.Validation: Adds non-destructive validation. Requires an authorized, in-window engagement.
profiles.AdversarySimulation: Requires explicit adversary-simulation approval; this framework remains read-only and does not execute exploitation.

controls.title: Service accounts do not hold owner/editor/admin roles
controls.expectedState: No project service account is bound to roles/owner, roles/editor, or an *Admin role.

controls.title: Service accounts have no user-managed keys
controls.expectedState: Every service-account key is Google-managed; no user-managed keys exist.

controls.title: User-managed service-account keys are rotated
controls.expectedState: Any user-managed service-account key is younger than the rotation threshold (default 90 days).

controls.title: Basic owner/editor roles are not granted to users or groups
controls.expectedState: User, group, and domain principals hold predefined or custom roles, not basic owner/editor roles.

controls.title: Cloud audit logging covers all services and users
controls.expectedState: The project audit configuration enables ADMIN_READ, DATA_READ, and DATA_WRITE for allServices with no exempted members.

controls.title: A catch-all log sink exports all log entries
controls.expectedState: At least one enabled, unfiltered log sink exports every log entry from the project.

controls.title: Buckets are not publicly accessible
controls.expectedState: No bucket IAM policy grants access to allUsers or allAuthenticatedUsers.

controls.title: Buckets enforce uniform bucket-level access
controls.expectedState: Every bucket enables uniform bucket-level access (no legacy per-object ACLs).

controls.title: The auto-created default network does not exist
controls.expectedState: The project does not contain the auto-created 'default' VPC network.

controls.title: Firewall rules do not allow 0.0.0.0/0 ingress to admin ports
controls.expectedState: No enabled ingress firewall rule allows 0.0.0.0/0 to ports 22 or 3389.

controls.title: VPC subnetworks enable flow logs
controls.expectedState: Every standard VPC subnetwork has flow logs enabled.

controls.title: Instances do not run as the default compute service account
controls.expectedState: No non-GKE instance uses the default Compute Engine service account.

controls.title: Instances do not have external IP addresses
controls.expectedState: Compute instances have no external (NAT) IP addresses.

controls.title: OS Login is enabled at the project level
controls.expectedState: Project metadata sets enable-oslogin=TRUE and no instance overrides it to false.

controls.title: Interactive serial-port access is disabled
controls.expectedState: No instance sets serial-port-enable to true.

controls.title: Symmetric CMEK keys rotate within the threshold
controls.expectedState: Every enabled symmetric Cloud KMS key has a rotation period no longer than the baseline threshold (default 90 days).

controls.title: Cloud SQL instances are not open to the world
controls.expectedState: No Cloud SQL instance authorizes 0.0.0.0/0 as a client network.

controls.title: Cloud SQL instances require TLS connections
controls.expectedState: Every public-IP Cloud SQL instance requires TLS for client connections.

controls.title: Project break-glass procedure is documented
controls.expectedState: A documented, tested break-glass procedure exists for organization and project owner access.
